out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. Handout provided to CFM.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Quaternary Ammonium Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the quaternary ammonium compound-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in the 3-compartment sink with a concentration of zero ppm total quaternary ammonium compound. The Quaternary Ammonium Compound(QAC) was not utilized during the cleaning of utensils at the 3-vat sink. Utensils were observed washed and rinsed but not sanitized. This step was skipped.
violations.corrective_action: The quaternary ammonium sanitizer used in this facility shall have a minimum concentration of at least 200 ppm OR a concentration between 200-400ppm based on the manufacturer's use directions and using the appropriate test kit. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION. Train the dish washing employees to always set up the sink ready to WASH-RINSE-SANITIZE, before air drying the utensils.

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: shaved chicken shawama=94F, shaved beef shawarma=86F stored at room temperature .
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. Provide proper equipment for hot-holding of foods. BOTH ITEMS WERE DISCARDED DURING THE INSPECTION .

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name.Unmarked spray bottles that are holding toxic cleaning chemical solutions were not labeled to identify contents.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: Several unmarked squeezer bottles containing hard-to- identify foods were not observed labeled to identify contents.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Toilet Room, Kept Closed
violations.observation: Observed that toilet room doors are being kept open. Then self-closing device was not operating properly.
violations.corrective_action: Keep toilet room doors closed to prevent insect and rodent entrance and the associated spread of potential disease. Install a good working self-closing device on each restroom door.

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Storage Areas/Receptacles, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The waste storage container/dumpster located outside is in disrepair.
violations.corrective_action: Storage areas, enclosures, and receptacles for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be maintained in good repair.

violations.title: Refuse Areas & Enclosures Maintained Clean
violations.observation: Trash and litter were observed adjacent to the dumpsters/refuse container outside the facility.
violations.corrective_action: A storage area and enclosure for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be maintained free of unnecessary items and kept clean. Maintain the area around the dumpsters in clean condition .

violations.title: Inside Receptacle, Covered if Full/Not in Use
violations.observation: Observed filled refuse containers stored in the establishment containing food residue wastes without lids. Dumpster is missing a side lid and a cover at the top.
violations.corrective_action: Receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be kept covered inside the food establishment if the receptacles and units contain food residue and are not in continuous use or after they are filled. Replace the lid and cover or replace the dumpster.

violations.title: Outside Receptacle, Tight Fitting Lids
violations.observation: Outside refuse container /dumpster was uncovered.
violations.corrective_action: Receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be kept covered with tight fitting lids or doors if kept outside the food establishment.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the outside area at the back of the restaurant in the is not marinated in clean condition. Debris, trash and liquid waste were observed in the area.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. Clean the back exterior areas properly to control for pests. No equipment is to be cleaned outside in the back area.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the ceiling tiles above the food prep areas are not in place, exp;owing food and food contact surfaced to possible contamination. The seal/cover is missing at the SANITIZING COMPARTMENT of the 3-compartment sink, prevent proper sanitizing of utensils after rinsing.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Replace the missing ceiling tiles in place. Provide the sink drain cover for the sanitizing compartment sink.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Required
violations.observation: The food establishment's Permit to Operate is no longer valid due to expiration of the permit. No person shall operate a food establishment unless that person possesses a valid permit issued by the Health Department.
violations.corrective_action: To obtain a current Permit to Operate, contact the Health Department at (703) 246-2201 within 48 hours to make payment of the permit renewal fee. You may provide payment by cash, check, or credit card. Failure to pay the permit renewal fee and obtain a current Permit to Operate within 48 hours may lead to further enforcement actions by the Health Department including immediate closure.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Observed raw marinated chicken stored above vegetables, in the walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc.

violations.title: Cover Foods in Storage
violations.observation: Unwrapped or uncovered food in the following location where the food is subject to contamination: Observed raw marinated ed cooked beans stored uncovered in the walk-in refrigerator
violations.corrective_action: Foods shall be protected from contamination by being stored in packages, covered containers or wrappings unless being cooled.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: steamed rice= 127F, sliced beef gyro=126F, on serving steam table.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. Reheated during the inspection.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: beans, gyro, cooked sauces, cooked lamb, noted in the walk-in refrigerator with no date markings.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. This was corrected during the inspection. TASTY CHICKEN 3 (Inspection Date: 01/06/2026) Page 2 of 3
